$comment: Highest number of `unclassified` ownership entries this repository still tolerates. It ratchets DOWN, never up: when a maintainer decides what one of the reported symbols is (or the schema gains a kind for it), lower this number in the same change. Raising it hides drift, which is the exact failure P0 exists to prevent. Initialised on 2026-08-20 to the count the first generator run produced: 23 compound-component injection keys (no `injection-key` kind in schema 1.0.0), plus DzResolver, cn, themeScript, getThemeScript, warnDeprecated, resetDeprecationWarnings (no `utility` kind).
$comment.maxWithoutAnatomy: Highest number of PUBLIC COMPONENTS still allowed to ship without a declared anatomy (TASK-OSS-P3-02, ADR-19). Same ratchet, same rule: it falls when a component declares one, and raising it is how a styling contract quietly stops being one. Initialised on 2026-08-20 at 142 of 143 -- DzButton is the only component in the catalog that has declared what a consumer may address. Lowered to 138 on 2026-08-21 when TASK-OSS-P3-03 landed the five pilots -- DzButton, DzInput, DzSelect, DzDialog and DzTable (DzDialogContent also declares one, but it is a compound part and compound parts are not counted). Lowered to 137 on 2026-08-21 when TASK-OSS-P4-02 added DzProvider and DzThemeProvider: the catalog grew by one public component (DzProvider) and gained two declarations, so the number of components WITHOUT one fell by one. Both declare parts: 'none' -- renders no element of its own -- which ADR-19 counts as a declaration precisely so that 'renderless' is a promise rather than an omission. Lowered to 136 on 2026-08-24 when TASK-OSS-P5-06 added DzFileUpload: the capability-matrix gate refuses to leave a Tier D evidence row empty, and `rtl-contract` was the cell with nothing behind it. The rollout takes it to 0. Lowered to 113 on 2026-09-02 by TASK-N2-S1, which rolled the contract out by COMPLETE FAMILY rather than by scattered component: `inputs` 8/8 (DzInputGroup, DzInputMask, DzNumberInput, DzOtpInput, DzPasswordInput, DzSearchInput, DzTextarea joining the DzInput pilot), `buttons` 8/8 (DzButtonGroup, DzCopyButton, DzFab, DzIconButton, DzSpeedDial, DzSplitButton, DzToggleButton joining the DzButton pilot), `typography` 8/8 (all eight, none of which had one), plus DzCodeBlock -- the alignment case, which had emitted six data-part names since before ADR-19 was written and declared none of them. -23 in one change; three families are now completely declared and can be described as such. Note the arithmetic the task brief got wrong: there was never a set of 13 undeclared PUBLIC emitters, so the alignment pass moved this number by 1, not 13. See docs/program-2026-09/reports/N2-S1-anatomy-rollout-handoff.md section 1. Lowered to 88 on 2026-09-04 by TASK-R5-O2, which continued the rollout in the N2-S1 section-10 ranked order and declared 25 more: `cards` 3/3 complete (DzCard with its three compound parts, DzImageCard, DzStatCard), `feedback` 4 (DzBlockUI, DzNotification, DzToast, plus DzSpinner out of tier order because four already-declared components render it and it was not an anatomy boundary until it declared one), `layout` 6/6 Tier B+ (DzCollapse, DzPanel, DzResizable, DzScrollArea, DzSplitter, DzToolbar), `media` 3/3 Tier B+ (DzCarousel, DzImageComparison, DzLightbox) and `overlays` 9/9 Tier B+ (DzCommandPalette, DzConfirmDialog, DzContextMenu, DzDropdownMenu, DzPopconfirm, DzPopover, DzSheet, DzTooltip, DzTour). Scope note for the arithmetic: TASK-R5-O2 declares TIER B AND ABOVE, so the Tier A remainder of feedback, layout and media is deliberately still counted here. `forms` (26) is untouched and blocked on S1-D4; `navigation` (12) and `data` (17) are the next slices. See docs/program-2026-09-04/reports/TASK-R5-O2-handoff.md. Lowered to 65 on 2026-09-04 by the TASK-R5-O2 CONTINUATION packet, which completed the two remaining unblocked families in the N2-S1 section-10 ranked order and declared 23 more: `navigation` 12/12 -- the whole family, since every public component in it is Tier B or above (DzAnchor, DzBackTop, DzBreadcrumb, DzColorModeToggle, DzMegaMenu, DzMenu, DzPagination, DzSegmented, DzSidebar, DzStepper, DzStepperItem, DzTabs) -- and `data` 11/12 Tier B+ (DzAccordion, DzCalendar, DzChip, DzDataGrid, DzDataView, DzInfiniteScroll, DzListItem, DzOrderList, DzTag, DzTree, DzTreeItem, joining the DzTable pilot). Tier B+ coverage is now 65/89. `forms` (24 Tier B+) is the ONLY family left and stays untouched: the prompt's own stop_conditions say to skip it while S1-D4 / owner decision D15 (the DzOptionsState disposition) is untaken, so 65 is the reachable floor for this task shape and the prompt's <= 55 target needs `forms` (see D14, and D20 in the continuation handoff). See docs/program-2026-09-04/reports/TASK-R5-O2-handoff.md section: Continuation session 2. Lowered to 41 on 2026-09-04 by the TASK-R5-O2 FORMS packet, which completed the last family and every remaining Tier B+ component in the catalogue. The owner took decision D15 (N2-S1 S1-D4 / ADR-19 packet D19-10) as option (d) — each of the seven DzOptionsState hosts declares `options-state`, `options-message` and `options-retry` itself, which is the rule validate:anatomy-parts rule 1 already implemented for an unmanifested internal, so no schema change and no new mechanism were needed. 24 more declarations: DzCascader, DzCheckbox, DzCheckboxGroup, DzColorPicker, DzCombobox, DzDatePicker, DzDateRangePicker, DzFieldArray (parts: none — it renders no element of its own), DzInplace, DzKnob, DzListbox, DzMention, DzMultiSelect, DzPersonaSelector, DzRadio, DzRadioGroup, DzRangeSlider, DzRating, DzSlider, DzSwitch, DzTagsInput, DzTimePicker, DzTransfer and DzTreeSelect, joining the DzSelect pilot and DzFileUpload. Tier B+ coverage is 89/89 — every Tier B, C and D component in the catalogue now declares an anatomy. The 41 that remain are Tier A, which TASK-R5-O2 deliberately excludes; lowering this number further is a Tier A packet, not a continuation of this one. See docs/program-2026-09-04/reports/TASK-R5-O2-handoff.md section: Continuation session 3.
